# sanity_dataset (Resource)

Manages a Sanity.io dataset within a project. Datasets hold documents and assets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a production dataset
resource "sanity_dataset" "production" {
  project_id = sanity_project.example.id
  name       = "production"
  acl_mode   = "public"
}

# Create a staging dataset
resource "sanity_dataset" "staging" {
  project_id = sanity_project.example.id
  name       = "staging"
  acl_mode   = "public"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the dataset (e.g. `production` or `staging`). Dataset names cannot be changed after creation.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Sanity project to which this dataset belongs.

### Optional

- `acl_mode` (String) Access Control List mode: `public` or `private`. Note: `private` requires a paid Growth or Enterprise plan.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the dataset was created.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format `<project_id>/<dataset_name>`.
